topics.name: Machine Learning
topics.description: The study of algorithms and statistical models that enable computers to perform tasks without explicit instructions.

sub_topics.name: Supervised Learning
sub_topics.description: A type of machine learning where the model is trained on labeled data.

sub_topics.name: Unsupervised Learning
sub_topics.description: A type of machine learning that deals with unlabeled data.

sub_topics.name: Semi-Supervised Learning
sub_topics.description: A blend of supervised and unsupervised learning using both labeled and unlabeled data.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of programming and statistics.
common_misconceptions: Machine learning can solve any problem
More data always leads to better models

topics.name: Deep Learning
topics.description: A subset of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers.

sub_topics.name: Artificial Neural Networks
sub_topics.description: Computational models inspired by the human brain's network of neurons.

sub_topics.name: Activation Functions
sub_topics.description: Functions that determine the output of a neural network node.

sub_topics.name: Backpropagation
sub_topics.description: An algorithm for training neural networks by minimizing the loss function.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra, calculus, and programming in Python.
common_misconceptions: Deep learning is the same as machine learning.
More layers always mean better performance.

topics.name: Gradient Descent
topics.description: An optimization algorithm used to minimize the loss function in machine learning models.

sub_topics.name: Learning Rate
sub_topics.description: A hyperparameter that controls how much to change the model in response to the estimated error.

sub_topics.name: Stochastic Gradient Descent
sub_topics.description: A variant of gradient descent that updates the model using a single training example.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of calculus and linear algebra.
common_misconceptions: Gradient descent always finds the global minimum.
A smaller learning rate is always better.

topics.name: Loss Functions
topics.description: Functions that measure how well a machine learning model performs.

sub_topics.name: Mean Squared Error
sub_topics.description: A common loss function for regression tasks.

sub_topics.name: Cross-Entropy Loss
sub_topics.description: A loss function often used for classification tasks.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning and statistics.
common_misconceptions: All loss functions are the same

topics.name: Regression
topics.description: A type of predictive modeling technique that estimates relationships among variables.

sub_topics.name: Linear Regression
sub_topics.description: A method for modeling the relationship between a scalar response and one or more explanatory variables.

sub_topics.name: Logistic Regression
sub_topics.description: A statistical method for predicting binary classes.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and algebra.
common_misconceptions: Only linear relationships can be modeled
practical_applications: Predicting sales based on advertising spend
Estimating housing prices based on features

topics.name: Classification
topics.description: The task of predicting the category of a given data point.

sub_topics.name: Binary Classification
sub_topics.description: A classification task with two possible outcomes.

sub_topics.name: Multi-Class Classification
sub_topics.description: A classification task with more than two possible outcomes.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and programming.
common_misconceptions: Classification is only for binary outcomes.

topics.name: Transformers
topics.description: A type of model architecture that uses self-attention mechanisms for processing sequential data.

sub_topics.name: Self-Attention Mechanism
sub_topics.description: A technique that allows the model to weigh the importance of different words in a sequence.

sub_topics.name: Transformer Architecture
sub_topics.description: A model architecture that relies on attention mechanisms rather than recurrent layers.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of neural networks and sequence data.
common_misconceptions: Transformers are only for NLP tasks
Self-attention is the same as recurrent processing

topics.name: Probability Theory
topics.description: A branch of mathematics concerned with the analysis of random phenomena.

sub_topics.name: Bayesian Inference
sub_topics.description: A method of statistical inference in which Bayes' theorem is used to update the probability of a hypothesis.

sub_topics.name: Random Variables
sub_topics.description: Variables whose possible values are numerical outcomes of a random phenomenon.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of algebra and statistics.
common_misconceptions: Probability is the same as chance
Independent events cannot affect each other

topics.name: Design Engineering
topics.description: The discipline of designing and developing systems and products using engineering principles.

sub_topics.name: System Design
sub_topics.description: The process of defining the architecture, components, modules, interfaces, and data for a system.

sub_topics.name: Product Development
sub_topics.description: The complete process of bringing a new product to market.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of engineering principles and design processes.
common_misconceptions: Design engineering is only about aesthetics.
Engineering design does not require creativity.
